# Subway Seat for Thunderbird

The folder pane, message list, spaces toolbar and tabs, with burnt orange for the selected space and primary buttons. Thunderbird installs the unsigned .xpi directly.

[Thunderbird](https://www.thunderbird.net) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/thunderbird/) · Needs Thunderbird 115+

| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.xpi`](subway-seat.xpi) | Add-ons and Themes › ⚙ › Install Add-on From File… |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Thunderbird › Tools › Add-ons and Themes:

```text
⚙ › Install Add-on From File… › subway-seat.xpi
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Thunderbird › Tools › Add-ons and Themes:

```text
⚙ › Install Add-on From File… › subway-seat-tunnel.xpi
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Thunderbird › Tools › Add-ons and Themes:

```text
⚙ › Install Add-on From File… › subway-seat-enamel.xpi
```

## Follow light and dark

In Thunderbird › Tools › Add-ons and Themes:

```text
⚙ › Install Add-on From File… › subway-seat-auto.xpi
# Enamel while the system is light, Subway Seat (Walnut) while it's dark
```
